outfall.name: Outfall
outfall.desc: Daylight dies behind you. The sewer runs north into the dark.

junction.name: The Junction
junction.desc: Four tunnels meet in a pool of slurry. Side passages go east and west.

gear_nook.name: Gear Nook
gear_nook.desc: A toothed gear sits on a dry ledge, just out of the muck.

cog_nook.name: Cog Nook
cog_nook.desc: A round cog, a shirt of rings, and a red vial share a niche.

wheel.name: Wheel Door
wheel.desc: An iron wheel door fills the north tunnel. Two pegs on it are empty.

nest.name: The Nest
nest.desc: The tunnel opens into a nest of brick and bone.

wheel_door.desc: The wheel door waits on two empty pegs, one round and one toothed.
wheel_door.success_msg: Both pegs fill. The wheel turns and the door rolls aside.
wheel_door.fail_msg: That does not fit either peg.
